findings.detail: The maturity date was parsed as 2002-08-08, but the source maturity cell for 123Dentist Inc. shows 08/08/2 9, a future 08/08/29 maturity.

rationale: Class 1 single-cell check. The flagged stored maturity_date is 2002-08-08, before the 2025-09-30 report date. Raw source table 8 row 25 shows the 123Dentist Inc. maturity cell as 08/08/2 9, which is a split rendering of 08/08/29 and is not matured as of the report date. The flag therefore exposes a real extraction/normalization error in the stored maturity_date.
